deviations: Frozen profile geco3-l9 is measured once per dataset, not three times: a 1,048,576-byte pilot exceeded 120 s and the protocol cap is 180 s. Repeating an operation that cannot finish adds no information.
geco3-l3 and geco3-l6 are supplementary profiles added after the l9 pilot to provide feasible GeCo3 baselines. They are marked origin=supplementary and are not part of the frozen protocol.
JARVIS3 and GeCo3 run only when every sequence byte is A/C/G/T, per the protocol. gzip, xz, and HyperGraSS run on all sequence inputs.
Every tool consumes the exact .seq bytes. FASTA metadata is not part of this comparison; complete-FASTA results are reported separately by the PanMAN benchmark.

contracts.fasta: Exact downloaded FASTA bytes, including all headers, order, wrapping and line endings.
contracts.sequence: Exact deterministic concatenation of sequence lines in downloaded record order, with only FASTA headers and line endings removed. No case folding, ambiguity removal, gap removal or record dropping. Raw-only tools are applicable only when every resulting byte is A/C/G/T. This contract does not preserve FASTA metadata.

datasets.label: E. coli K-12 MG1655 laboratory reference
Budding yeast chromosomes I, II and III; naturally distinct records
Two E. coli K-12 laboratory references; MG1655 and W3110

limitations: Local measurement, not a third-party independent replication.
Ten inputs, including overlapping component records in the multi-record cases; not ten statistically independent genomes.
Small-to-medium references and two multi-record cases, not a population-scale pangenome corpus.
No raw FASTQ reads, large mammalian chromosomes, or gigabase collections.
Fixed representative tool profiles, not a parameter sweep or a claim about each tool's best possible configuration.
Sequence-only scores cannot be compared directly with complete FASTA scores.
Shared host, filesystem caches and JVM startup affect runtime; three samples do not establish statistical significance.

measurement.failures: Retain errors, timeouts, missing tools and verification failures. No wins from incomplete or nonmatching comparisons.
measurement.memory: Per-child Linux wait4 ru_maxrss converted from KiB to bytes; not heap size or Docker memory limit.
measurement.order: Rotate tool order by dataset and repetition; new process per operation; no engine tuning after results.
measurement.wall: Process startup through exit, inside the same Linux container. Docker startup, downloads, builds, staging and SHA verification excluded.

protocol.selection: Frozen before running any new compressor measurements. Public accession-version records not used for development in this workspace; selected for varied sizes and single/multiple records, not observed compressibility. This is a locally conducted held-out benchmark, not an independent third-party audit.
